spec.description: Input JSON schema jarvis.notes-input.v1 contains sources [{id,text}]. Return schema jarvis.notes-result.v1 with excerpts equal to sources: preserve exact text, uncertainty, source IDs and input order. No summary or added facts. Implement pure run(text)->str for valid structured inputs. Return JSON exactly as json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")); no extra keys, prose or side effects. Generalize over inputs, never hardcode examples. This contract does not cover arbitrary language or real business delivery.
